contract: Scope-refusal controls compare the actual constructor or compact-selection refusal with the scope established independently from the reference catalogue after draining. The remaining cases use the mpegts-pes packet projection.

The unregistered observer uses the AVC constructor and literal payload output. The input-bound and compact observers select the carriage from the accepted PMT and use the actual cursor. Compact output is consumed through its span cursor.

The candidate folds the observer packet fields and the demux clock projection of its applicable header. Check each owned or borrowed span against its offered carrier, input bytes and source context, including the physical bounds of M2TS prefixes. Require the compact span iterator and consuming cursor to produce the same sequence of spans with identical provenance.

The pinned formats worker opens the selected program with public MPEG-TS AVIO, NOPARSE and NOFILLIN, without stream discovery. It delivers ordinary entities in one AVIO source and flushes at a declared discontinuity.

The packet fold is the mpegts-pes fold: stream index, PID, PTS and DTS in 90 kHz ticks (INT64_MIN for absence), duration, position, flags, size, bytes and every side-data element. Input loading is outside the run. Both sides drain the last entity to logical end.
Every operation in the mpegts-pes corpus runs for each form, retaining its 272 request mappings and the hash of every ordered input.

open_deviations.clause: H.222.0 §2.4.3.5 defines PCR extension as the system-clock count modulo 300.
open_deviations.candidate: Rejects the affected carrier and emits no PES from it.
open_deviations.reference: Returns the 27-byte PES payload at PTS 90000.

open_deviations.clause: H.222.0 §2.4.3.5 permits OPCR only in a transport packet containing PCR.
open_deviations.candidate: The strict source walk rejects the unpaired OPCR carrier and none of the three observers emits a packet.

open_deviations.reading: Transport error indication marks untrustworthy payload
open_deviations.clause: H.222.0 §2.4.3.3 defines TEI as at least one uncorrectable error in the transport packet.
open_deviations.candidate: Does not publish a PES from the errored carrier.
open_deviations.reference: Returns 27 bytes at PTS 90000 without a corrupt flag.

open_deviations.reading: User-defined scrambling flag requires an interpretation before clear payload delivery
open_deviations.clause: H.222.0 §2.4.3.3 Table 2-4 distinguishes scrambling from clear payload.
open_deviations.candidate: Does not publish a PES from the scrambled carrier.
open_deviations.reference: Returns the 27 bytes and PTS 90000 as a packet.

open_deviations.reading: A zero PTS marker bit violates the PES header grammar
open_deviations.clause: H.222.0 §§2.4.3.6–2.4.3.7 Table 2-21 requires the timestamp marker bits.
open_deviations.candidate: Rejects the malformed header and emits no PES.
open_deviations.reference: Returns 27 bytes with PTS and DTS 90000.

open_deviations.reading: PES timestamp flag value 01 is forbidden
open_deviations.candidate: Rejects the malformed header and emits no PES.
open_deviations.reference: Returns 27 bytes with both clocks absent.

open_deviations.reading: Finite startup requires complete transport carriers
open_deviations.clause: H.222.0 §§2.4.3.1–2.4.3.2 fix the 188-byte packet extent. The finite observer binding validates the supplied entity before delivery.
open_deviations.candidate: Refuses the finite source with a partial final carrier.
open_deviations.reference: Emits the 27-byte packet on the complete prefix.

open_deviations.reading: Finite startup requires sync on the supplied grid
open_deviations.clause: H.222.0 §2.4.3.3 requires 0x47 at the start of each carrier. The finite observer binding validates every sync byte.
open_deviations.reference: Emits the 27-byte packet on the intact portion.

open_deviations.reading: PES optional data exceeds the finite packet length
open_deviations.clause: H.222.0 §§2.4.3.6–2.4.3.7 place the optional header within the declared PES length.
open_deviations.candidate: Refuses the malformed header with Invalid.
open_deviations.reference: Silently reaches EOF with no selected packet.

open_deviations.candidate: Refuses the invalid prefix with Invalid.
open_deviations.reference: Silently reaches EOF with no selected packet.

open_deviations.reading: A bare observer requires explicit confirmation of the PCR timeline boundary
open_deviations.clause: H.222.0 §2.4.3.5 distinguishes system time-base discontinuity from continuity-counter discontinuity. The bare observer requires separate clock policy before combining packets across the boundary.
open_deviations.candidate: Publishes the first PES at 90000 ticks, then refuses the new source-clock boundary.
open_deviations.reference: Publishes the first PES at 90000 ticks and a second PES at 10 ticks without a separate caller confirmation.
